title: GitHub View
purpose: GitHub issues and pull requests browser for the active cluster's repository
states: no-repository - cluster not in git repo
acceptance: shall display issues and pull requests together
shall allow filtering by kind (all, issues, pull requests)
shall allow filtering by state (open, closed, merged, any)
shall show empty state with explanation for each error condition
shall display 'Sign in' button when not authenticated
shall allow typing custom search queries
shall show loading indicator while fetching
shall support starting work on items by creating branch
